description: Hand-maintained annotations for the generated native Tool catalog reference. The generator extracts `native.*.*` ids from crates/cognitive-kernel/src/tool_registry.rs and fails on any bidirectional mismatch.

tools.description_en: Bounded read of a validated relative path inside an admitted workspace root.
tools.description_zh: 在已准入 workspace 根内对经校验相对路径的有界读取。

tools.description_en: Bounded search within admitted workspace roots.
tools.description_zh: 在已准入 workspace 根内的有界搜索。

tools.description_en: Governed workspace write; requires the persist-before-dispatch Intent/Effect path.
tools.description_zh: 受治理的 workspace 写入；要求 persist-before-dispatch 的 Intent/Effect 路径。

tools.description_en: Governed workspace patch (patch-shaped payload enforced by the pre-executor validator).
tools.description_zh: 受治理的 workspace patch（预执行校验器强制 patch 形状载荷）。

tools.description_en: Bounded registered check-command execution with timeout, output caps, and supervision.
tools.description_zh: 有界的已注册检查命令执行，含超时、输出上限与监督。

tools.description_en: Read-only HTTPS GET/HEAD against an exact registered origin allowlist; no userinfo, query, or fragment. An explicit port is part of the exact origin pin.
tools.description_zh: 只读 HTTPS GET/HEAD，仅限精确注册的 origin 白名单；不允许 userinfo、query 或 fragment。显式端口是精确 origin 钉的一部分。

tools.description_en: Run one immutable daemon-registered deterministic check selected only by check_id; executable, argv, cwd, environment, timeout, output, process-tree, write-root, network and digest bounds are fixed.
tools.description_zh: 仅按 check_id 运行 daemon 不可变登记的确定性检查；可执行文件、argv、cwd、环境、超时、输出、进程树、写入根、网络和 digest 边界全部固定。
